facts.text: Kat's on the phone the whole way down Route 23.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Kat Jennings as a businesswoman Kimberly stops from entering Route 23, and the survivors later ride in her SUV. The transcript has no phone scene for her.
facts.fix: Kat's SUV is the one the survivors pile into.

facts.text: Room Key: Last Stop Motel, Room 12, check-out 10am
facts.why: This is a menu slip, not a film fact: the key card printed on the same face says Checkout 11, so the line is changed to 11am to match.
facts.fix: Room Key: Last Stop Motel, Room 12, check-out 11am
